rules.rationale: Logs drop themselves when broken by hand or any tool.
Stone needs at least a wooden pickaxe and drops cobblestone.
Coal ore needs at least a wooden pickaxe and drops coal.
One log makes four planks in the inventory grid.
Two stacked planks make four sticks.
Four planks in a 2x2 make a crafting table.
Three planks across the top and two sticks down the middle.
Three cobblestone across the top and two sticks down the middle.
Coal over a stick makes four torches.
In this world coal ore needs a stone pickaxe or better, so a wooden pickaxe breaks it without dropping anything.
In this world coal ore may need a stone pickaxe, so the wooden pickaxe removes the block with no drop.
In this world coal ore may drop nothing, so mining it yields no items with any tool.
In this world coal ore may need a stone pickaxe, so a wooden pickaxe breaks it but drops nothing.
